mapper.select: SELECT erc.erc_id AS recordId, IFNULL(u.nick_name, u.user_name) AS candidate, pos.pos_title AS jobName, cmp.cmp_name AS companyName, CAST('' AS CHAR) AS language, CASE WHEN erc.erc_start_at IS NULL OR erc.erc_submit_at IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, erc.erc_start_at, erc.erc_submit_at), '分钟') END AS duration, erc.erc_total_score AS score, CASE erc.erc_status WHEN 4 THEN '0' WHEN 1 THEN '1' WHEN 2 THEN '2' WHEN 3 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS status, erc.erc_submit_at AS submitTime, CAST('' AS CHAR) AS remark FROM t_exam_record erc LEFT JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = erc.erc_candidate_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = tal.tal_user_id LEFT JOIN t_exam_schedule esd ON esd.esd_id = erc.erc_schedule_id LEFT JOIN t_pos pos ON pos.pos_id = esd.esd_position_id LEFT JOIN t_cmp cmp ON cmp.cmp_id = pos.pos_company_id ORDER BY COALESCE(erc.erc_submit_at, erc.erc_created_at) DESC, erc.erc_id DESC
